blocks.prompt: 7 (i) (a) A stone falls from a height of 60m on the ground, the height \(h\) after \(x\) seconds is approximately given by \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\). What is the height of stone when \(x = 1\) sec?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh asal zindagi ka "value of a function" sawal hai: \(h(x)\) batata hai ke \(x\) seconds baad pathar zameen se kitne metre upar hai.
Diya kya hai? \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\) aur waqt \(x = 1\) second.
Find kya karna hai? Us waqt pathar ki unchai.
Plan: \(x = 1\) rakh kar operations ki sahi tarteeb se hisaab: pehle square, phir 10 se guna, phir 40 mein se minus.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\), \(x = 1\) s.
Humein find karna hai: \(h(1)\).
Tareeqa: Formula mein \(x = 1\) rakhenge. Tarteeb ka khayal zaroori hai: power pehle, phir multiply, phir minus.

Rakhein aur hisaab karein
\[h(1) = 40 - 10(1)^2\]
\[= 40 - 10(1)\]
\[= 40 - 10 = 30\]
Kyun: Pehle square: \(1^2 = 1\); phir \(10 \times 1 = 10\); phir \(40 - 10 = 30\). Yani 1 second baad pathar zameen se 30 m upar hai.
Dhyan dein: Pehle \(10 \times 1\) kar ke phir square karna ghalat hai; square sirf \(x\) ka hai, 10 ka nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[0 < 30 < 40\]
Kyun: Unchai zameen (0) aur shuru ki unchai (40 m) ke darmiyan honi chahiye, aur jitna zyada waqt guzre utni kam honi chahiye, kyunke pathar neeche gir raha hai. Hamara jawab is par poora utarta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein likha hai ke pathar "60m ki unchai" se girta hai, lekin formula ke mutabiq shuru mein (\(x = 0\)) unchai \(h(0) = 40 - 0 = 40\) m hai. Dono baatein aapas mein nahi miltin. Saare parts (aur kitab ke jawab 30 m, 17.5 m, 11.1 m, 2 sec) formula par chalte hain, is liye asal shuru ki unchai 40 m hai. Sawal ko "40 m ki unchai se" parhein.

blocks.prompt: 7 (i) (b) A stone falls from a height of 60m on the ground, the height \(h\) after \(x\) seconds is approximately given by \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\). What is the height of stone when \(x = 1.5\) sec?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh asal zindagi ka "value of a function" sawal hai: \(h(x)\) batata hai ke \(x\) seconds baad pathar zameen se kitne metre upar hai.
Diya kya hai? \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\) aur waqt \(x = 1.5\) second.
Find kya karna hai? Us waqt pathar ki unchai.
Plan: \(x = 1.5\) rakh kar operations ki sahi tarteeb se hisaab: pehle square, phir 10 se guna, phir 40 mein se minus.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\), \(x = 1.5\) s.
Humein find karna hai: \(h(1.5)\).
Tareeqa: Formula mein \(x = 1.5\) rakhenge. Tarteeb ka khayal zaroori hai: power pehle, phir multiply, phir minus.

Rakhein aur hisaab karein
\[h(1.5) = 40 - 10(1.5)^2\]
\[= 40 - 10(2.25)\]
\[= 40 - 22.5 = 17.5\]
Kyun: \(1.5^2 = 1.5 \times 1.5 = 2.25\); phir \(10 \times 2.25 = 22.5\); phir \(40 - 22.5 = 17.5\). Aadhe second mein pathar 30 m se 17.5 m tak aa gaya, kyunke girte hue us ki raftaar barhti jati hai.
Dhyan dein: Pehle \(10 \times 1.5\) kar ke phir square karna ghalat hai; square sirf \(x\) ka hai, 10 ka nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[0 < 17.5 < 40\]
Kyun: Unchai zameen (0) aur shuru ki unchai (40 m) ke darmiyan honi chahiye, aur jitna zyada waqt guzre utni kam honi chahiye, kyunke pathar neeche gir raha hai. Hamara jawab is par poora utarta hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 (i) (c) A stone falls from a height of 60m on the ground, the height \(h\) after \(x\) seconds is approximately given by \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\). What is the height of stone when \(x = 1.7\) sec?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh asal zindagi ka "value of a function" sawal hai: \(h(x)\) batata hai ke \(x\) seconds baad pathar zameen se kitne metre upar hai.
Diya kya hai? \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\) aur waqt \(x = 1.7\) second.
Find kya karna hai? Us waqt pathar ki unchai.
Plan: \(x = 1.7\) rakh kar operations ki sahi tarteeb se hisaab: pehle square, phir 10 se guna, phir 40 mein se minus.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\), \(x = 1.7\) s.
Humein find karna hai: \(h(1.7)\).
Tareeqa: Formula mein \(x = 1.7\) rakhenge. Tarteeb ka khayal zaroori hai: power pehle, phir multiply, phir minus.

Rakhein aur hisaab karein
\[h(1.7) = 40 - 10(1.7)^2\]
\[= 40 - 10(2.89)\]
\[= 40 - 28.9 = 11.1\]
Kyun: \(1.7^2 = 1.7 \times 1.7 = 2.89\); phir \(10 \times 2.89 = 28.9\); phir \(40 - 28.9 = 11.1\). Pathar ab zameen ke kaafi qareeb hai.
Dhyan dein: Pehle \(10 \times 1.7\) kar ke phir square karna ghalat hai; square sirf \(x\) ka hai, 10 ka nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[0 < 11.1 < 40\]
Kyun: Unchai zameen (0) aur shuru ki unchai (40 m) ke darmiyan honi chahiye, aur jitna zyada waqt guzre utni kam honi chahiye, kyunke pathar neeche gir raha hai. Hamara jawab is par poora utarta hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 (ii) A stone falls from a height of 60m on the ground, the height \(h\) after \(x\) seconds is approximately given by \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\). When does the stone strike the ground?
blocks.explanation:
"Zameen se takrata hai" ka matlab hai ke us waqt unchai zero hai.
Diya kya hai? \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh waqt \(x\) jab \(h(x) = 0\).
Plan: \(40 - 10x^2 = 0\) solve karna, aur negative waqt ko radd karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(x) = 40 - 10x^2\).
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) jab \(h(x) = 0\).
Tareeqa: Lafzon wale sawal ko equation mein badalna asal kaam hai: "zameen par" = "unchai 0". Phir aam equation ki tarah hal karenge.

Unchai ko zero rakhein
\[40 - 10x^2 = 0\]
\[10x^2 = 40\]
\[x^2 = 4\]
Kyun: Zameen par pathar ki zameen se unchai 0 hai. \(10x^2\) ko doosri taraf le gaye (sign badal gaya), phir dono taraf 10 se divide kiya.

Square root lein
\[x = \pm 2\]
\[x = 2 \text{ (time cannot be negative)}\]
Kyun: \(2^2 = 4\) aur \((-2)^2 = 4\), is liye maths do jawab deti hai. Lekin waqt us lamhe se gina ja raha hai jab pathar chhora gaya (\(x = 0\)), to negative waqt ka koi matlab nahi. Is liye sirf \(x = 2\).
Dhyan dein: Maths ke har jawab ko sawal ke context mein parkhein; yahan \(-2\) ko radd karna zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq
\[h(2) = 40 - 10(4) = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 2 second par unchai bilkul 0 hai. Aur part (c) mein 1.7 second par abhi 11.1 m baaqi thi, to 2 second ka jawab mantiqi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Pathar \(x = 2\) seconds baad zameen se takrata hai.
